text: APPROVE: Each extracted helper keeps the original logic, including the Create and Apply branch order, the (0,1) then (1,0) index preference, and the skip when neither order fits. `BuildPlan`'s complexity drops to roughly 6, and the `is var (eventIndex, documentIndex)` pattern on the nullable tuple compiles and leaves both variables definitely assigned in the branch body. I only reviewed the diff and did not build it, so the one residual risk is a member-ordering analyzer objecting to the `const` placed between methods.
